$comment: Generated from the port ledger; one entry per ported-react-or-studio row in tests/e2e/PORT-LEDGER.md.

scenarios.title: In edit mode, clicking an item body selects it and the edit overlay shields interactive content inside the item from the click.
scenarios.setup: Edit mode on; one item renders an interactive child button that records clicks.
scenarios.action: Click the item body over the child button.
scenarios.assertion: Item reports selected; the child button click counter stays at 0.

scenarios.title: Clicking a child inside a group selects the child directly; the parent group never appears in the selection-change log.
scenarios.setup: Group containing two children; selection-change listener records every selected id.
scenarios.action: Click the first child.
scenarios.assertion: Recorded selection ids never include the group id; child ends selected.

scenarios.title: In edit mode there is no top-centre move handle; a resize handle becomes active only when the pointer nears the matching edge of the selected item.
scenarios.setup: Edit mode; one item selected.
scenarios.action: Hover the item centre, then hover 2 px inside its east edge.
scenarios.assertion: No move handle exists; zero active resize handles at centre, exactly one active east handle at the edge.

scenarios.title: Outside edit mode, an item with free move/resize policy can be dragged via its proximity move handle and shows an active east handle on edge hover.
scenarios.setup: View mode (no edit chrome); two side-by-side items with free move and resize.
scenarios.action: Hover top-centre to reveal the move handle, drag the item down 120 px; then hover the east edge.
scenarios.assertion: Item y increased by ≈120; exactly one active east resize handle appears.

scenarios.title: A 5 px drag of a child inside a group shows a drop preview that stays inside the group rect and never re-parents the child.
scenarios.setup: Root with a header group and a body group; body group has two children.
scenarios.action: Pointer-down on a body child, move 5 px, hold; then release.
scenarios.assertion: Every drop-preview rect lies inside the body-group rect (±4 px); after release the child depth is unchanged.

scenarios.title: A pointercancel during a pending drag leaves the item in place; a real drag suppresses text selection on the document and clears it after drop.
scenarios.setup: Two stacked items, edit mode.
scenarios.action: Pointer-down + 1 px move, dispatch pointercancel, release; then drag the first item down over the second.
scenarios.assertion: After cancel, item position unchanged (<3 px) and no selection-suppressed flag; during the drag a selection-suppressed flag is set and window selection is empty; after drop the flag is cleared and the neighbour moved down ≥20 px.

scenarios.title: Edit mode overrides per-item movement/resize locks meant for end users: a locked header item can be moved and resized while editing.
scenarios.setup: Header group with a title item whose end-user movement and resize are locked; edit mode on.
scenarios.action: Drag the title 160 px east; then drag its east handle +60 px.
scenarios.assertion: Title x increased and width increased.

scenarios.title: While dragging over a sibling, a drop preview appears at the swap target; a later resize of the swapped item does not compact it back.
scenarios.setup: Two side-by-side items with a gap; swap policy.
scenarios.action: Drag left item over the right item and hold; release; then resize the right item east by 40 px.
scenarios.assertion: During hold, preview x ≈ right item original x (<8 px); after resize the right item x/y unchanged (<8 px).

scenarios.title: After a cross-group drop, the committed item rect equals the drop preview shown just before release (within 3 px).
scenarios.setup: Header group + body group; body has two children.
scenarios.action: Drag a body child into the header, hold, read preview rect, release.
scenarios.assertion: Committed x/y equal preview x/y within 3 px.

scenarios.title: Arrow moves the selected item one step, Shift+Arrow ten steps, Ctrl+Arrow grows the east edge with the left edge anchored.
scenarios.setup: Item with free space on every side; select it.
scenarios.action: Press ArrowRight, Shift+ArrowRight, Control+ArrowRight.
scenarios.assertion: x grows by a small step (<3 px), then by ≥5x that step; then width grows while x stays (≤1 px).

scenarios.title: Outside edit mode, hovering near an item edge activates that resize handle for items with resize allowed.
scenarios.setup: View mode; item with resize allowed.
scenarios.action: Move pointer to 2 px inside the east edge.
scenarios.assertion: Exactly one active east resize handle for that item.

scenarios.title: The move handle stays invisible while hovering the bottom of an item and only appears near the top-centre.
scenarios.setup: View mode; one item.
scenarios.action: Hover 8 px above the item bottom; then hover 2 px below its top-centre.
scenarios.assertion: Handle opacity <0.2 at the bottom, >0.9 at the top-centre.

scenarios.title: While dragging over a sibling, a drop preview is shown at the swap target position.
scenarios.setup: Two side-by-side items.
scenarios.action: Drag the left item over the right one and hold.
scenarios.assertion: A drop preview exists and its x ≈ right item x (<8 px).

scenarios.title: An item whose end-user movement is locked can still be dragged to the adjacent slot in edit mode.
scenarios.setup: Header with a movement-locked title and an action item to its right; edit mode on.
scenarios.action: Drag the title right to the slot beside the action item.
scenarios.assertion: Title x moved by at least half the distance to the action item.

scenarios.title: Clicking a child inside a group in edit mode selects the child, not the group.
scenarios.setup: Group with two children; edit mode on.
scenarios.action: Click a child.
scenarios.assertion: Child selected; group not selected.

scenarios.title: During a drag the active item has a higher z-index than the drop preview.
scenarios.setup: Two side-by-side items.
scenarios.action: Drag one over the other and hold.
scenarios.assertion: computed z-index(active) > z-index(preview).

scenarios.title: Dragging a group south handle 800 px below the page clamps the group at the canvas bottom instead of snapping back to its initial size when the pointer leaves.
scenarios.setup: Group with room below it; select the group; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Drag its south handle to y = bottom + 800 and release.
scenarios.assertion: Group bottom == canvas inner bottom (±2 px); height grew.

scenarios.title: After pointer-down, a 4 px pointer move already translates the item by 4 px (no drag threshold lag).
scenarios.setup: One item; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Pointer-down on the drag surface, move +4,+4 in one step, hold.
scenarios.assertion: Item x/y == before + 4 (<2 px).

scenarios.title: In edit mode a resize-locked group below a header can be shrunk from its north handle.
scenarios.setup: Header + resize-locked body group; edit mode on.
scenarios.action: Hover the body top edge, drag the north handle down 80 px.
scenarios.assertion: Group y increased ≥40 and height decreased ≥40.

scenarios.title: While a group is being resized from the north (before release), its children have already shrunk.
scenarios.setup: Group with two children; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Drag the group north handle down 100 px and hold.
scenarios.assertion: Child height already decreased ≥40 px mid-drag.

scenarios.title: Pointer-down on empty space inside a group drags the group; clicks on children still target the child.
scenarios.setup: Group with two children and empty space between them; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Pointer-down in the empty space, drag 60 px down, release.
scenarios.assertion: Group y increased ≥30; children moved with it.

scenarios.title: While a header is resized south (before release), the neighbour group shrinks and its children visibly move with it.
scenarios.setup: Header group above a body group with children; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Drag the header south handle down 80 px and hold.
scenarios.assertion: Body child y increased ≥40 mid-drag.

scenarios.title: Dragging a north handle far past a blocking header leaves the live rect at the last valid position (header.bottom + gap), not at the pointer.
scenarios.setup: Header (locked) above a body group; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Drag the body north handle to viewport y=4 and hold.
scenarios.assertion: Body y stays > header.bottom (well above 4).

scenarios.title: Pointer capture keeps a resize alive when the pointer leaves the canvas; returning and releasing commits the final position.
scenarios.setup: Group with a north handle; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Drag down 40, move to x=2000 (outside canvas), move back to +60, release.
scenarios.assertion: Group y increased ≈60 (≥40).

scenarios.title: Two consecutive north resizes (release between them) both commit.
scenarios.setup: Group with north handle; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Resize north +80, release; resize north +60, release.
scenarios.assertion: Second resize moved y ≥30 and shrank height ≥30 relative to the first result.

scenarios.title: Releasing a resize while the pointer is in invalid territory commits the last valid preview, never the pre-drag size.
scenarios.setup: Locked header above a body group; edit mode; first shrink body north by 100 and release.
scenarios.action: Start a new north resize and release at viewport y=4 (over the header).
scenarios.assertion: Body y ≥ shrunk y − small tolerance (not back to the original); height ≤ shrunk height.

scenarios.title: In edit mode a resize-locked group still paints an active north handle on proximity and can be shrunk from it.
scenarios.setup: Resize-locked body group; edit mode on.
scenarios.action: Hover its top edge; drag the north handle down 80 px.
scenarios.assertion: Active north handle count is 1; group y increased and height decreased ≥40.

scenarios.title: Pointer-down on item B while A is selected switches selection to B before release.
scenarios.setup: Two items; A selected.
scenarios.action: Pointer-down on B and move 10 px without releasing.
scenarios.assertion: B selected and A not selected mid-drag.

scenarios.title: During an east resize the neighbour shrinks live; retreating the handle below its origin restores the neighbour to its original width.
scenarios.setup: Two side-by-side items; shrink policy.
scenarios.action: Drag the left item east handle +120 and hold; then move to −30 and hold.
scenarios.assertion: Neighbour width < original − 60 mid-expand; |neighbour width − original| ≤ 4 after retreat.

scenarios.title: During a cross-group drag the active item visual and the drop preview share the same rect (≤2 px on every axis).
scenarios.setup: Header group + body group.
scenarios.action: Drag a header child into the body group and hold.
scenarios.assertion: active rect == preview rect within 2 px (x, y, w, h).

scenarios.title: When a root-level drag pushes a sibling group during preview, that group children move with it (no stale child rects until release).
scenarios.setup: Root with a header group (with a child) and a body item below.
scenarios.action: Drag the body item up into the header and hold.
scenarios.assertion: Header child y moved by ≈ the header displacement mid-drag.

scenarios.title: Dragging a child south handle never resizes the parent group, even when the child fills the parent on that axis.
scenarios.setup: Group with a child that fills the group height; edit mode; select the child.
scenarios.action: Drag the child south handle +120 and release.
scenarios.assertion: Group height unchanged (±2 px).

scenarios.title: A selected non-root group exposes a delete action that removes the group and its children.
scenarios.setup: Root with a header group.
scenarios.action: Select the group (via a child then the parent crumb); click its delete action.
scenarios.assertion: Group element count becomes 0.

scenarios.title: Dragging a palette entry over a fully packed group shows a drop preview inside that group.
scenarios.setup: Packed group (two children filling it); palette open.
scenarios.action: dragstart on a palette entry; dragenter/dragover at the group centre.
scenarios.assertion: Exactly one drop preview and its x-span lies inside the group rect (±4 px).

scenarios.title: While a palette entry hovers a packed group, the existing children shrink or move live before drop.
scenarios.setup: Packed group; palette open.
scenarios.action: dragstart palette entry; dragover the group; measure a child; dragleave.
scenarios.assertion: Child width, height, or position changed by >4 px during hover.

scenarios.title: Dropping an item into the gap between two groups shrinks the lower group during preview and its children stay inside the shrunken rect.
scenarios.setup: Header group with a child; body group with children below; gap between.
scenarios.action: Drag the header child into the inter-group gap and hold.
scenarios.assertion: Body child rect ⊆ body group live rect (±4 px).

scenarios.title: Pressing Delete removes the selected item.
scenarios.setup: Two items; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Click the second item; press Delete.
scenarios.assertion: Item selected after click; element count 0 after Delete.

scenarios.title: Click-to-add into a selected, fully packed group grows the group rather than overflowing.
scenarios.setup: Packed group selected; palette open.
scenarios.action: Click a palette entry.
scenarios.assertion: Group height after ≥ height before − 4.

scenarios.title: Click-to-add places the new item fully inside the canvas bounds.
scenarios.setup: Layout with existing items; palette open.
scenarios.action: Click a palette entry.
scenarios.assertion: Item count +1 and the new item rect ⊆ canvas rect.

scenarios.title: In edit mode a fixed-size item can be resized from its south-east handle and the new size becomes its fixed size.
scenarios.setup: Fixed-size item; edit mode; select it.
scenarios.action: Drag the south-east handle +60,+60; release.
scenarios.assertion: Width and height grew ≈60; inspector fixed width/height reflect the new values.

scenarios.title: A fixed 121x36 child keeps its size while its fixed-height parent group is grown then shrunk in edit mode; the child itself can then be resized directly.
scenarios.setup: Fixed-height header group containing a fixed 121x36 child; edit mode.
scenarios.action: Resize the group south +100, then back; then drag the child north-east handle +30,−30.
scenarios.assertion: Child stays 121x36 through the group resizes; group shrinks back ≥40; child then changes size during its own resize.
